title: CodexWorkerResponse
description: Typed response schema for Codex worker agents. Workers MUST return output conforming to this schema.

status.description: Task completion status. 'complete' = all objectives met. 'partial' = some gaps remain. 'failed' = could not fulfill request.

summary.description: 3-5 sentence executive summary of findings or work completed.

findings.description: Structured findings from research or analysis tasks.

source.description: URL or reference for the claim.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on source quality and corroboration.

evidence.description: Direct quote or specific data point supporting the claim.

artifacts.description: Files created, modified, or code samples produced.

content.description: Inline content for code_sample or small data artifacts.

gaps.description: Questions that could not be answered or areas needing follow-up.

escalations.description: Issues requiring router/user attention. Worker should NOT attempt to resolve these.
